problem_text:
A logistics manager must select cargo containers to load onto a freight truck. Available containers are:
* Container 1: weight 36 tons, revenue $292
* Container 2: weight 16 tons, revenue $227
* Container 3: weight 16 tons, revenue $121
* Container 4: weight 40 tons, revenue $59
* Container 5: weight 22 tons, revenue $99
* Container 6: weight 46 tons, revenue $161
* Container 7: weight 7 tons, revenue $239
* Container 8: weight 29 tons, revenue $113
* Container 9: weight 42 tons, revenue $253
* Container 10: weight 17 tons, revenue $255
* Container 11: weight 13 tons, revenue $241
* Container 12: weight 43 tons, revenue $91
* Container 13: weight 39 tons, revenue $119
* Container 14: weight 37 tons, revenue $216
* Container 15: weight 23 tons, revenue $230
* Container 16: weight 17 tons, revenue $209
* Container 17: weight 11 tons, revenue $77
* Container 18: weight 47 tons, revenue $287
* Container 19: weight 32 tons, revenue $66
* Container 20: weight 16 tons, revenue $186
* Container 21: weight 44 tons, revenue $299
* Container 22: weight 18 tons, revenue $13
* Container 23: weight 20 tons, revenue $238
* Container 24: weight 14 tons, revenue $212
The truck has a maximum weight capacity of 451 tons. Choose the container combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this weight limit. Each container must be either fully loaded or left behind.
